summary: Tested Bike KM Ledger MVP end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (POST/GET/DELETE /api/rides, /api/summary, validation: km<=0 -> 422, bad date -> 400, 404 on missing ride). Frontend Dashboard loads at /, all bento sections render with correct data-testids, week navigator (prev/next/Today) works, add-ride flow updates table+totals, delete ride updates tally, progress bar caps at width:100% and applies stripes class when over 100km goal. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/rides returns 200 by spec; returning 201 would be more REST-correct but matches FastAPI default and frontend works fine.
Frontend uses local Date in todayWeekKey() while backend computes current_week_key from UTC date; near midnight users in different timezones may briefly disagree. Low priority for single-user app.
AddRideForm: `dayOfWeekDateForKey` constructs Monday in UTC then adds dayIdx; ride_date sent is UTC-based which is consistent with backend's UTC week math. OK.
No rate limiting / auth (out of scope per problem statement: single user, no auth).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed rides and clean them up via DELETE; fixture teardown also sweeps any remaining TEST_* rides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all routes. ISO week per server is currently 2026-W18. Frontend works against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All required data-testids exist (app-logo, week-navigator, week-label, prev/next-week-btn, goto-today-btn, weekly-progress-card, week-total-km, progress-bar-fill, all-time-card, all-time-km, add-ride-section, ride-title-input, ride-km-input, day-MON..day-SUN, submit-ride-btn, recent-weeks-card, week-history-{key}, ride-list-section, rides-table, ride-row-{id}, delete-ride-{id}).
